column1: # PDFs on insp.cd that are not situation reports of this epidemic, and why.
# `scripts/check_upstream.py` requires every PDF uploaded since the epidemic
# began to be EXPLAINED: accepted by `parse_row` in
# `scripts/fetch_sitrep_index.py`, refused by that file's `_EXCLUDE` pattern,
# or matched by a row here. A PDF none of the three explains stops the daily
# run (check exit 2) and starts the fixing agent. That is the point: the
# filename predicate is an allowlist on a site we do not control, and twice a
# rename turned it into a silent refusal of every new report (the series
# renamed at 083 in August, and dropped `MVE` at 179 in November).
# One row per SERIES, not per file, so a weekly bulletin does not need a line
# a week. `pattern` is a Python regular expression, matched case-insensitively
# with `re.search` against the filename. Keep patterns anchored and narrow: a
# broad pattern here is exactly the silent refusal this register exists to end.
# `example` is one real filename the pattern matches, and a test checks that
# it does.
pattern
^Repartition_hebdomadaire_des_cas_deces_letalite_SE\d+_20\d\d
column3: INSP's weekly profile of every notifiable disease, presented at the national coordination committee (CNC). Not a situation report. It does carry five pages on this epidemic, including cases and case fatality by age and sex; it has not been read as a source.
